presentation.description: Pay for greater spell damage with your own blood, turning self-inflicted wounds into power behind your most demanding attacks. An action point attack leaves its victims bleeding, while your second wind can set already-afflicted enemies alight. Your spells punish foes for moving and leave crowds dazed beneath lingering psychic pain, and you can sacrifice a healing surge to recover a spent encounter power when the battle demands more magic.

presentation.description: Step through space as easily as another wizard crosses a room, eventually gaining teleportation as a normal way to move. Critical hits let you teleport your victims, and an action point carries you to a better position before the fight can pin you down. Your spells send allies to safety and enemies into danger, whisk you away from an incoming attack, and finally strand a group of creatures in an interplanar space until they find their way back.

presentation.description: Build a lasting bond with your summoned creatures, keeping them in the fight with healing and, eventually, regeneration. An action point lets you command each of your summons, while conjuration and summoning spells carry you a short teleport out of danger. A planar gateway scatters creatures that stray too close, and your greatest servant is a towering protector that dazes crowds, knocks attackers down, and can trade places with you in an instant.

presentation.description: Master the fundamentals of arcane magic until even your simplest spells set up stronger follow-up attacks and strike with greater force. Your schooling sharpens your Arcana knowledge, while an action point gives you a chance to correct a missed attack. You can pour extra power into familiar spells, reclaim an encounter attack that misses every target, and eventually turn a practiced encounter spell into a more punishing assault with longer-lasting effects.

presentation.description: Train for the battlefield, turning a chosen single-target wizard spell into a basic attack that fits naturally into your companions' tactics. Your action point attacks let you cast ranged and area spells without provoking opportunity attacks, while critical hits with close and area attacks eventually punish every target more severely. Sweeping lightning prepares your next strike, a selective barrier shields you from distant attacks while letting your spells through, and a thunderous assault leaves its targets open to your allies.
